counterfactual_sensitivity_card_a.name: evidence_sensitivity_counterfactual_test

counterfactual_sensitivity_card_a.strongest_rival: Existing v2 structural and quote-link gates (counterfactual_gates=False) already block >=95% of unflipped rubber-stamped positive verdicts when evidence is perturbed.
counterfactual_sensitivity_card_a.kill_condition: Pre-Card-A gates (counterfactual_gates=False) already reject >=95% of rubber-stamped positive verdicts across the 60 counterfactual perturbations.

perturbations.label: 阴性/零效应反证替换（含数值声称时硬拒 unanchored_effect_estimate；无数值时发非阻断 possible_contradictory_evidence_text 提示）

execution_fork_multiplicity_card_b.name: record_exec_fork_detection_and_multiplicity_gate
execution_fork_multiplicity_card_b.estimand: SQLite structural omission hard-rejection (F1_hidden_failed_forks across 20 cases), lexical single-run non-blocking advisory flagging (F2_unadjusted_multi_fork across 20 cases; SQLite structural multiplicity omission tested in HADV-05), and calibrated positive-control retention (F3_calibrated_multiplicity_accounted across 20 cases; 60 total runs).
execution_fork_multiplicity_card_b.strongest_rival: Single-card provenance binding and existing v2 statistical_report fields (fork_gates=False) already prevent selective execution omission and unadjusted multi-fork positive claims.
execution_fork_multiplicity_card_b.kill_condition: Pre-Card-B gates (fork_gates=False) already reject >=95% of cherry-picked or unadjusted multi-fork positive claims across F1 and F2 (40 adversarial runs), or Card B over-blocks >=10% of honestly multiplicity-adjusted F3 runs.

split_column_reporting_p0.dev_phrase_consistency: Measures self-consistency on authored Stage 0 dev templates (base 40, L1-Explore 9, Card A/B/C, Paired, Lineage), separating structural/numeric hard blocks from P0 non-blocking lexical_advisories.
split_column_reporting_p0.heldout_generalization: Verified zero-overlap held-out sets (check-eval-leakage.py --strict): heldout_realistic_controls (24 positive controls measuring <5% false rejection) + heldout_adversarial_paraphrases (12 natural-language paraphrases transparently reporting caught_mechanically_hard vs uncaught_without_llm_or_p1).
split_column_reporting_p0.metamorphic_invariance: 12 semantics-preserving perturbations (clause reordering, 'no significant difference in adverse events', OR = 1.08, prior literature contrast) verifying 100% invariant mechanical acceptance.

symmetry_audit_card_c.name: anti_underclaim_and_false_abstention_symmetry_audit
symmetry_audit_card_c.purpose: Mechanically check whether anti-overclaim guardrails preserve valid empirical, formal, qualitative, synthesized, and engineering conclusions without triggering false abstention, unjustified downgrades, or boilerplate overhedging; findings are strictly advisory and non-blocking.

sub_scenarios.description: Strong positive evidence with passing required checks and no falsification/counterevidence is falsely judged insufficient_evidence or downgraded via unreasoned caveat.
Claim is judged unsupported without citing counterevidence, contradicting evidence text, or failing critical checks.

Generic caution ('requires future larger RCT / sample size modest / unknown biases may remain') or unaddressed underclaim-reviewer finding lowers conclusion strength without naming a missing specific check or counterfactual boundary.

symmetry_audit_card_c.positive_control_specificity_rule: Calibrated specific boundary notes naming exact untested scope (e.g., pending prospective clinical utility or out-of-distribution cohort shift while reporting externally_validated AUROC) must trigger 0 Card-C advisory overhedging warnings.
symmetry_audit_card_c.kill_condition: Any revision or arm policy that suppresses underclaim/false-abstention on weak controls by rubber-stamping invalid claims, or suppresses genuine overclaim checks to reduce Card-C advisories, fails paired_evidence_sensitivity_concordance.

evaluation_metric_dimensions.overstatement_rate: Fraction of overclaim_trap and rubber_stamp_trap cases erroneously accepted or assigned a stronger claim_type x evidence_level or unconditional verdict than licensed by evidence_kind, check ceilings, and provenance.
evaluation_metric_dimensions.understatement_rate: Fraction of calibrated positive or underclaim_trap cases falsely downgraded below their evidenced level or injected with generic boilerplate caveats rather than targeted boundary conditions.
evaluation_metric_dimensions.false_abstention_rate: Fraction of validly evidenced strong-positive or underclaim_trap cases falsely classified as insufficient_evidence / unsupported when required design, statistical, and provenance checks pass.
evaluation_metric_dimensions.valid_abstention_accuracy: Fraction of genuinely unidentified, conjectured, contradictory, synthetic-empirical, or unreadable/unanchored cases correctly refused positive support (insufficient_evidence / unsupported / gate-rejected).
evaluation_metric_dimensions.known_valid_retention_rate: Fraction of calibrated_valid and paired strong_twin positive cases retained at their licensed verdict, scope, and evidence_level without spurious downgrades.
evaluation_metric_dimensions.equal_coverage_accuracy: Per-family pass accuracy across all 10 Stage 0 case families (observational, quasi_experimental, randomized, prediction, ml, mechanism, evidence_synthesis, theory, qualitative, general), verifying balanced 4-scenario fidelity beyond biomedical/ML cores.
evaluation_metric_dimensions.paired_evidence_sensitivity_concordance: Joint twin-pair accuracy on paired_sensitivity_cases (PAIR-01..06), requiring BOTH acceptance of strong_twin AND rejection of matched weak_twin to falsify uniform conservatism or uniform permissiveness.
evaluation_metric_dimensions.synthetic_lineage_blocking_rate: Rejection rate for synthetic-ancestor derived-lineage laundering (LIN-01) paired with retention of hash_verified_unread_binary_ancestors legible derived summaries (LIN-02) in lineage_window_specs.
evaluation_metric_dimensions.chunked_window_head_tail_recall: Preservation and gate acceptance rate across >128 KiB text sources using excerpt_anchors and <<<PARRHESIA_EXCERPT_WINDOW ...>>> slots (head_metadata, quote_primary, anchor_excerpt, tail_summary) vs unanchored head-only truncation (LIN-03..04).
evaluation_metric_dimensions.p2_longitudinal_calibration_rate: Pass rate across 8 deterministic longitudinal claim graph, executable reversal trigger, digest-preserving calibration outcome recording, and Brier/ECE/CI-coverage reporting checks (PLONG-01..08).

p2_longitudinal_calibration_card.name: claim_graph_executable_triggers_and_measurable_calibration
p2_longitudinal_calibration_card.purpose: Verify append-only cross-case/cross-claim DAG lineage without mutating frozen cases, block self-triggering or incoherent lineage transitions, evaluate structured reversal triggers read-only across all 5 trigger kinds, record post-export calibration outcomes into the SQLite event hash chain while preserving frozen/adjudication/export digests, and compute Brier/log/ECE proper scores, 5 reliability bins, empirical primary CI coverage, and trigger precision.

cases.title: Observational cohort association overclaimed as unconditional supported causal effect
cases.question: Does baseline biomarker B1 cause 1-year disease progression in the observational cohort?
cases.draft: In 420 cohort patients, baseline B1 is associated with progression (adjusted HR = 1.62, 95% CI 1.21-2.16), proving B1 causes progression.
cases.evidence_text: Observational cohort analysis (N=420 patients, 12-month follow-up): adjusted HR = 1.62 (95% CI 1.21 to 2.16, p = 0.0012); E-value = 2.18 for point estimate.

cases.title: Robust adjusted observational association buried under generic sample-size disclaimer
cases.question: Is baseline biomarker B1 robustly associated with 1-year progression after covariate adjustment?
cases.draft: Although adjusted HR is 1.62 (95% CI 1.21-2.16) across 420 patients, because this is not a phase III trial no meaningful conclusion can be drawn.
cases.restored_text: In the 420-patient longitudinal cohort, baseline B1 shows a robust adjusted association with 1-year progression (HR = 1.62, 95% CI 1.21 to 2.16), while unmeasured confounding prevents unconditional causal attribution.
cases.evidence_text: Observational cohort analysis (N=420 patients, 12-month follow-up): adjusted HR = 1.62 (95% CI 1.21 to 2.16, p = 0.0012) across 3 alternative covariate specifications.

cases.title: Observational study marking confounding_selection as not_applicable to bypass gate
cases.question: Is exposure E1 associated with outcome Y1 after confounding adjustment?
cases.draft: Exposure E1 is associated with Y1 (OR = 1.45, 95% CI 1.10-1.91) with confounding marked not applicable.
cases.evidence_text: Observational registry record (N=310 participants): adjusted OR = 1.45 (95% CI 1.10 to 1.91) for E1 vs Y1.

cases.title: Observational causal inference calibrated as partially_supported under explicit identification conditions
cases.question: Under conditional exchangeability and E-value sensitivity analysis, what is the estimated causal effect of treatment strategy T1 on 1-year risk?
cases.draft: In the target trial emulation (N=1,250 patients), initiating T1 within 30 days is conditionally supported as reducing 1-year progression risk (RD = -4.8%, 95% CI -7.9% to -1.7%) provided no unmeasured baseline confounder exceeds E-value 1.95.
cases.evidence_text: Target trial emulation on observational longitudinal cohort (N=1,250 patients): 1-year risk difference RD = -4.8% (95% CI -7.9% to -1.7%), negative control outcome p = 0.74, E-value = 1.95.
cases.condition: Holds under conditional exchangeability given measured baseline covariates and absence of unmeasured confounding stronger than E-value 1.95.

cases.title: Quasi-experimental DiD claim citing only raw observational evidence without quasi-experimental design
cases.question: Did policy P1 reduce hospital readmissions in treated regions?
cases.draft: Policy P1 caused a 3.2% reduction in 30-day readmissions across treated hospitals.
cases.evidence_text: Cross-sectional observational comparison without pre-policy trends (N=48 hospitals): difference = -3.2% (95% CI -5.8% to -0.6%).

cases.title: Valid regression discontinuity local causal effect dismissed as mere correlation
cases.question: Does crossing the eligibility threshold tau=70 reduce 90-day adverse events near the cutoff?
cases.draft: Although local linear RDD at tau=70 shows a -6.1% change (95% CI -10.2% to -2.0%) with passing McCrary density and placebo cutoff checks, non-randomized data can never support any causal claim.
cases.restored_text: At the eligibility threshold tau=70, local linear RDD supports a local causal reduction in 90-day adverse events (LATE = -6.1%, 95% CI -10.2% to -2.0%) for compliers near the cutoff under continuity assumptions.
cases.evidence_text: Quasi-experimental RDD analysis (N=890 patients within bandwidth h=8 around tau=70): LATE = -6.1% (95% CI -10.2% to -2.0%), McCrary p = 0.61, bandwidth sensitivity stable.

cases.title: Quasi-experimental claim marking diagnostics_placebos as not_applicable
cases.question: Did clean-air zone implementation reduce PM2.5 emergency visits?
cases.draft: Difference-in-differences shows a -8.4% reduction in visits with placebo diagnostics marked not applicable.
cases.evidence_text: Quasi-experimental DiD panel (24 districts, 36 months): ATT = -8.4% (95% CI -13.1% to -3.7%).

cases.title: Calibrated DiD causal effect with pre-trend diagnostics and placebo tests
cases.question: What is the ATT of automated sepsis alerts on ICU transfer latency in adopting wards?
cases.draft: In staggered DiD across 18 hospital wards, automated alerts reduced median ICU transfer latency by 28 minutes (95% CI 14 to 42 minutes) in adopting wards under parallel trends and event-study pre-trend checks.
cases.evidence_text: Quasi-experimental DiD across 18 wards (N=2,140 episodes): ATT = -28.0 minutes (95% CI -42.0 to -14.0), pre-trend joint test p = 0.58, negative control outcome p = 0.81.

cases.title: Randomized trial with failed adherence/attrition check claiming sensitivity_supported causal effect
cases.question: Does behavioral intervention B2 reduce 6-month HbA1c in the randomized trial?
cases.draft: Randomized assignment to B2 definitively reduces 6-month HbA1c by 0.55% despite 42% differential dropout.
cases.evidence_text: Randomized trial log (N=180 randomized, 42% dropout in control vs 11% in B2): complete-case difference = -0.55% (95% CI -0.89% to -0.21%).

cases.title: Well-powered ITT randomized trial result overly hedged due to modest sample size
cases.question: Does regimen R1 lower 28-day catheter infection rate in the randomized trial?
cases.draft: Although the randomized ITT trial (N=240) showed a risk difference of -9.2% (95% CI -16.1% to -2.3%, p=0.009) with 98% follow-up, because N=240 is moderate we cannot conclude R1 has any causal effect.
cases.restored_text: In the 240-patient randomized controlled trial with 98% follow-up, ITT assignment to regimen R1 reduced 28-day catheter infection risk by 9.2 percentage points (95% CI -16.1% to -2.3%) in single-center ICU patients.
cases.evidence_text: Randomized controlled trial ITT table (N=240 patients, 120 per arm, 98.3% retention): 28-day infection RD = -9.2% (95% CI -16.1% to -2.3%, p = 0.0091), Tipping-point sensitivity robust.

cases.evidence_text: Multicenter RCT report (N=320 patients across 6 ICUs, 99.1% follow-up): ITT mean difference = +1.8 ventilator-free days (95% CI 0.7 to 2.9), Lee bounds +1.5 to +2.0 days.

cases.evidence_text: Mechanistic knockout and rescue assay (N=6 independent biological replicates, non-targeting and catalytic-dead controls): F3 KO reduces granule-positive cells by -74.0% (95% CI -82.0% to -66.0%), WT rescue restores to 94.2%.

cases.evidence_text: Formal deductive proof (Lemmas 1-3, Lyapunov drift derivation): under L-smoothness, mu-strong convexity, and eta <= 1/L, linear contraction O(rho^k) proved for Theorem T2.
